delta.event_identity: replay-stable causal event SHA-256 bound to payload content digest, causal/generation/source/modality/observation/provenance

hypothesis: Splitting causal event identity from transport admission identity gives Entry, HCU routing, replay, XPU scheduling and future interconnect one reusable causal anchor without coupling semantic event identity to arrival time.
counterhypothesis: One digest over the derived route result is sufficient and cheaper.
cheapest_discriminators_source_obligatio: same causal event with new ingress arrival -> same event digest, different admission digest
changed payload digest -> changed event digest
same route result with different event -> different route digest
same event/result with different engine -> different route digest
same event/policy/engine/result replay -> identical route digest
